item.summary: Minister of State for Commerce and Industry, Shri Jitin Prasada, called on the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, Environment and Culture of the Principality of Liechtenstein, H.E. Ms. Sabine Monauni, today in New Delhi. The meeting focused on strengthening bilateral economic relations and exploring new avenues for trade and investment cooperation between India and…
item.title: Minister of State for Commerce and Industry, Shri Jitin Prasada, Calls on Liechtenstein Deputy Prime Minister to Strengthen Bilateral Trade and Investment Ties
